summary:
I found the job, created the doc and emailed Leo Chen; the doc and the email both show up in their apps. I used 45 of my 50 actions.

- **Job:** The only Technical Program Manager posting in LockedIn is at **Amazon**. It's full-time and on-site in Seattle, WA, paying $165K–$245K a year.
- **Key skills:**
  - 5–10+ years of relevant experience, including 2+ years in leadership
  - A track record of managing high-performing teams
  - Strong strategic thinking and stakeholder management
  - Experience with agile methods
- **Benefits:** Competitive salary; health, dental and vision insurance; a 401(k) with company match; and professional development.
- **Doc:** "Interview Prep" now appears in your CloudDocs list. It has a short job summary and two questions for the recruiter: what programs the role would own in the first 6 months, and how success is measured plus what the interview process looks like. Its link was private by default, so I changed it to "Anyone with link" so Leo can open it.
- **Email:** It's in your Sent folder, addressed to "Leo Chen", with the subject "Interview Prep - Technical Program Manager at Amazon". It includes the doc link and asks for his advice on your preparation. Mail never suggested an address for him, so I entered just his name. The app accepted it and shows the email as sent, but I couldn't confirm which address it went to.

ANSWER: Company: Amazon (Technical Program Manager, Seattle, WA). Key skills: 5-10+ years of relevant experience with 2+ years in leadership; managing high-performing teams; strategic thinking and stakeholder management; agile methods. Benefits: competitive salary ($165K-$245K/yr), health/dental/vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, professional development. The CloudDocs doc "Interview Prep" was created (link: https://clouddocs.example/document/d/doc_1/edit?usp=sharing) and the email with the link asking for advice was sent to Leo Chen.
